title: Quantifying attention via dwell time and engagement in a social media browsing environment
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus was on quantifying human attention via dwell time and engagement with social media posts, distinguishing between credible and sensational content.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
